item.text: The search found four distinct candidates: gSASRec’s calibrated loss, DuoRec’s contrastive regularization, FMLP-Rec’s frequency filters, and BERT4Rec’s masked-item training. I’ll treat them as hypotheses to test; their published results do not establish gains on this benchmark.
